{{Otheruses|reactor}}
[[File:R1series-NEGTD.png|thumb|right|200px|An R1 reactor drone]]
'''Reactor drones''' were a type of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] used for menial labor<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> in the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] rooms of large [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="The Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Models included the [[Mark II reactor drone/Legends|Mark II reactor drone]]<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe" /> and [[R1-series astromech droid/Legends|R1-series astromech droid]],<ref name="The Complete Visual Dictionary" /> also known as the R1 [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] drone.<ref name="junior novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' junior novelization]]</ref>
